summary: Blue Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a Second Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Blockfusion Data Centers and Pubco. The amendment increases the post-Closing incentive plan from 8% to 12% of Pubco common shares outstanding, amends listing exchange requirements for Pubco Class A common stock, and extends the Outside Date. No price, premium, or advisor terms stated. The filing amends a prior SPAC merger agreement, signaling progress toward de-SPAC combination. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory clearance; risk-arb focuses on redemption levels and incentive dilution.
